project.title: [Company] — AI Reception V1 Implementation
project.summary: AI voice receptionist with knowledge base, call recording, and human escalation. Clinic answers every inbound call 24/7 with accurate responses trained on clinic data.
objectives: 24/7 AI voice receptionist for inbound calls to clinic number
Clinic knowledge base setup (treatments, pricing, policies, FAQs)
Call recording and lead capture for all inbound enquiries
Escalation to clinic team with full context when AI cannot resolve
Calendly booking link integration for demo scheduling

included: VAPI AI voice agent configuration and deployment to clinic phone number
Clinic knowledge base build: treatments, pricing, policies, FAQs, Q&A setup
Call recording and lead capture (call logs stored, accessible in dashboard)
Human escalation rules and handoff to clinic team with full context
Calendly booking link integration (clinic manages own calendar)
VAPI configuration assistance and go-live support
Testing and live demo before Go-Live
deliverables: Live AI Receptionist configured for clinic phone number
Call recording and lead capture system
exclusions: Phone number provisioning (clinic provides or ports existing number)
Real clinic calendar sync (Calendly link only)
Content creation — clinic provides treatment/pricing/FAQ source material

milestones: Week 1: VAPI agent configuration + clinic content gathering
Week 2: Knowledge base training + escalation rules setup
timeline.notes: Timeline assumes clinic provides content on schedule. Delays in client content delivery may extend go-live.

vat.note: VAT status is unresolved; no tax determination is made in this proposal.

client_responsibilities: Provide clinic phone number (new or existing to be forwarded to VAPI)
Supply treatment/pricing/FAQ/policy content for knowledge base training
Manage Calendly calendar and sharing for booking demo links
Review and approve knowledge base before Go-Live
Timely testing and feedback during implementation phase
assumptions: Implementation fee (£497) is one-time; monthly billing (£297) starts at Go-Live
Monthly pricing includes VAPI AI voice service, knowledge base, call recording, escalation, Calendly link
Clinic provides phone number; Nexora configures VAPI routing
Knowledge base content (treatments, pricing, FAQs) is clinic-provided; Nexora trains and configures VAPI response logic
VAPI costs and infrastructure are included in monthly pricing (no overage charges for fair usage within clinic size)
Month-to-month billing: clinic can cancel anytime after Go-Live with 30-day notice
Future versions (A2, A3) will add WhatsApp, Instagram DM, web chat, SMS confirmations
next_steps: Following acceptance, a commercial agreement is executed before invoicing
